name: paper-to-slides
description: Turn research papers into self-contained Beamer slides with the paper's original figures and a timed speaker script.

description_i18n.en: Turn LaTeX projects, local PDFs, or accessible paper links into a self-contained Beamer deck, a compiled PDF, and a timed slide-by-slide speaker script.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 LaTeX 工程、本地 PDF 或可访问的论文链接，做成自包含的 Beamer 讲稿、编译好的 PDF，以及逐页配时的讲稿脚本。
